metadata.title: मिज़ोरम: MNF और ZPM में मुकाबला | Mizoram: MNF and ZPM main rivals, BJP-Cong not in race
metadata.description: Manipur's election campaign is notably peaceful compared to other Indian states, with a lack of hate speech and no instances of poll violence. The state has 40 seats, and it's a multi-corner contest, but the ruling Mizo National Front (MNF) and the Zoram People's Movement (ZPM) appear to be frontrunners in the election. The Congress party is likely to secure the third position, while the BJP seems to be out of contention.
